Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Game Overview 2 On Your Turn 3 Action Details 4 Scoring 5 Quilting Assistants 6 Ending the Game and Winning 7 Assistenten (Spezialfähigkeiten) 8 Spielvarianten 8.1 Fortgeschrittene Wertung: Symmetrie & Patches 8.2 Team-Variante 9 Solo-Regeln 10 Wertung (Zusammenfassung) 10.1 Advanced Scoring: Symmetry & Patches 10.2 Team Play 11 Solo Rules 12 Scoring Summary Game Overview You are quilters competing for the Quick Quality Quilters award by working to create the highest scoring quilt! Throughout the game you will sew a 4x4 quilt and collect patterns to help your quilt score points. Drag and drop to position cards in your quilt, and select the rotate button to rotate them. Clicking on the arrows beside your quilt will shift the whole quilt in that direction. On Your Turn On your turn you may take 1 or 2 actions: CHOOSE 2–3 connected quilt blocks. RETURN unwanted quilt blocks. PLAN by claiming patterns. Action Details When you CHOOSE blocks, drag-and-drop the selection into place, and rotate it until you are happy with their location. When you PLAN and take a pattern, that pattern card goes beside your quilt and applies at the end of the game. Every pattern can be completed multiple times in your quilt, though a single block cannot count twice for the same pattern. Patterns may be flipped or rotated for the sake of scoring. If you click on a pattern in your supply, the interface will show you everywhere that pattern has been completed in your quilt so far. Scoring At the end of the game, your quilt scores for the following criteria: 1 point per premium block. 5 points for completion. Points for each completed pattern. If you are playing with the advanced modules, the following criteria also apply: 3 points per completed patch (connected patches with matching shapes and locations). 15 points for a symmetrical quilt (empty squares count as wilds for the sake of symmetry). Quilting Assistants If playing with the Assistant module, you choose 1 of 2 assistants to play with, which will give you a unique power throughout the game. To use this ability, either click on the assistant card or on the button in the interface. Ending the Game and Winning After any player triggers the end of the game by finishing a quilt, each other player takes 1 more turn. The end of the game is also triggered if the pattern piles are all depleted. The player with the most points wins the game! Assistenten (Spezialfähigkeiten) Assistenten verleihen jedem Spieler eine einzigartige dauerhafte oder einmalige Fähigkeit. Zu Beginn erhält jeder Spieler eine Assistentenkarte: Der Designer: Erlaubt es, beim "Planen" zwei Musterkarten statt einer zu ziehen (man behält eine, die andere kommt unter den Stapel). Der Sammler: Erhöht das Handlimit für Musterkarten. Der flinke Näher: Erlaubt es, einmal pro Zug einen einzelnen Block aus der Auslage zu nehmen, ohne eine Aktion zu verbrauchen. Der Perfektionist: Bonusgelder für exakte Farbübereinstimmungen an den Rändern. Der Lehrling: Ermöglicht es, die "Rückgabe"-Aktion effizienter zu nutzen oder Karten im Quilt einmalig zu verschieben. Spielvarianten Fortgeschrittene Wertung: Symmetrie & Patches Für erfahrene Spieler können zusätzliche Punkte vergeben werden: Patches: Wenn die Symbole an den Kanten zweier benachbarter Karten genau zusammenpassen, entsteht ein "Patch", der am Ende Zusatzpunkte bringt. Symmetrie: Punkte für farbliche oder musterspezifische Symmetrie (horizontal, vertikal oder diagonal) im fertigen 4x4 Quilt. Team-Variante Spieler arbeiten in Paaren an einem gemeinsamen großen Quilt
